link.description: The link to send the person: shown once, never stored
link.title: Link

CrewFace.description: A super power as a thread shows it: its face and its name.
CrewFace.title: CrewFace

Face.description: A super power as a machine shows it: its face, its name, what it is doing there.
Face.title: Face

org.description: the org it acts in now: its newest sign-in's
org.title: Org

NewModel.description: From the catalog (`catalog_model_id`), or a model the catalog lacks (`provider` and its `model` id).
NewModel.title: NewModel

OrgCredit.description: What any member sees of their org's billing (the Account page): the plan, when it renews, the credit.
OrgCredit.title: OrgCredit

PaymentStart.description: What the page needs to show Stripe's Payment Element and confirm the payment there.
PaymentStart.title: PaymentStart

ToolChange.description: My own setting (no super power; "ask" clears it), or a super power's override ("ask" clears it).
ToolChange.title: ToolChange

User.description: A super power that uses a power, and how (a folder's read or write).
User.title: User

get.description: The catalog's models (one provider's, or all), searched, each saying whether I may add it.
The catalog's providers, each with how many models it offers and, when a limit leaves all out, why.
Services to connect (Pipedream's apps), by cursor: pass the page's `after` for the next.
My machines, connected first, each with its 8 most recently active super powers.

post.description: A one-minute, one-time link into the machine's UI, on its home or one of its super powers.

get.description: Every super power on one of my machines, searched and filtered, with how many of each status.
A machine's threads (Recents): pinned first, then the newest; by goal, by a super power, archived or not.

post.description: Start a thread on one of my machines: one super power on its own, or a crew Glyphh leads.

patch.description: Change my first or last name; an empty one clears it.

get.description: The agent hosts (Claude, Codex, ...) connected to my Glyphh.

delete.description: Disconnect one host: its tokens stop working at once; the others are untouched.

get.description: Every org I belong to, my Personal org first.
What the platform remembers for me: the theme, the rail, each list's rows per page.

patch.description: Change any of them; a list's rows per page are merged in by the list's name.

get.description: Every question my super powers are waiting on, across my machines, newest first.

post.description: Allow or deny, once: answered anywhere, it is closed everywhere, and the machine is told.

get.description: The Billing page in one read (org admins).

put.description: Turn auto top-up on or off: the trigger, the target, and an optional monthly cap.

post.description: Reload now if the balance is under the trigger.
Save a new card in the page, through Stripe's Payment Element.

get.description: Stripe's invoices, newest first, a page at a time by cursor (`after`: the last invoice's id).

post.description:
Switch plan: pay in the page (from Free), applying (an upgrade, once Stripe confirms) or scheduled (a
downgrade, at the period's end).
What a switch would charge now and on the next invoice, before anything is charged.
A link into Stripe's portal (payment methods, invoices, cancelling), back to Billing after.

get.description: This period's spend, day by day.

post.description: Ask Stripe directly what its webhooks would have said, then read the page again.

get.description: Each top-up, newest first, with when its credit expires.

post.description:
Start adding credit ($5 to $10,000): the page pays it in Stripe's Payment Element; credit lands when Stripe
confirms.

get.description: My org's plan, when it renews, and its credit this period: any member may read it.
The plans on sale now, each its current version.
The models and connections my teams allow, inside my org's list, with the teams that allow each.

post.description: Start connecting my account at a service: open the link (Pipedream's own sign-in), then check.
Ask Pipedream which account the connection is, after its sign-in.
A new sign-in link for the same connection.

get.description: The connection's tools, by risk, each with my permission and any super power's own.

patch.description: Set tools to Allow, Ask or Deny (mine, or a super power's own for its unwatched runs).

delete.description: Super powers lose it at once; the folder and its files stay on the machine.

post.description: Add a model on my own key: the key is tried with the provider first, and a refused one saves nothing.
Try the saved key with its provider again.
My platform session ends in every browser and org at once; connected AI hosts stay connected.

get.description: My threads found by their goal, and by what was said on every one of my machines that is online.

delete.description: Delete an archived thread for good, and its messages on its machine.

get.description: One thread's record, its machine and its open questions. Its messages are on the machine.

patch.description: Rename it, pin it to the top of Recents or not, archive it or bring it back.

get.description: A thread's events as its machine reports them, live: one Server-Sent Event each, numbered within the thread.
A page of a thread's events from its machine, oldest first: the newest, or those before a number.

post.description: Say more in a thread; its machine must be connected.
Stop the work in a thread; its record stays.
